summary: Mapped ticker relationships for the visible candidate chunk. The strongest relationship cluster is the sulphur/sulphuric-acid disruption chain: smelter-acid producers in Europe, Korea and Japan are potential second-order beneficiaries, while Indonesia-exposed nickel and fertilizer/minerals companies are potential cost/risk nodes. A separate low-attention cluster is India niche API suppliers, where the relationship is regulatory lock-in and China-plus-one diversification, but company-level evidence remains weak because the supplied source is anonymized. NVIDIA is retained only as a reference demand signal for AI infrastructure chokepoints and should not crowd out underfollowed supplier nodes.
